# Changelog notes

## When to use this
Use this when the user wants release notes built from a changelog.

## Procedure
1. Read the changelog.
2. Group entries by area.
3. Write one line per entry.

## Inputs
- The changelog file path.

## Checks
- The output has one line per changelog entry.
